overview: Black replies 1.Nf3 with ...a5, a Ware-style flank move that gains queenside space but does little for the centre. White can usually play d4 or c4 and aim for a comfortable advantage. I am unsure of the mainline, so tags follow the move.

white_ideas.idea: Occupy the centre with d4 or c4 and develop freely

black_ideas.idea: Gain queenside space and prepare ...Ra6 or ...b6 ideas
Fianchetto and aim at the centre from the flank

typical_structures.structure: Flexible flank structure, usually transposing to a Queen's Pawn or English set-up

character.notes: Slow first moves from both sides lead to quiet manoeuvring without forcing play.

soundness.notes: The ...a5 move is a minor loss of time, not a real flaw.

structure.notes: The centre is undecided at move one, so the structure stays flexible.

approach.notes: Played by strong players hardly at all; chosen for surprise.

level.notes: Little theory and unclear plans, rated intermediate.
